author: Pallas, 1776
status: 나그네새 10만 마리 이상 · 겨울철새 수백 마리 · 여름에도 드물게 기록(10건 미만)
summary: 대부분은 봄과 가을에 한반도를 지나가는 흔한 나그네새이지만, 일부는 우리나라에서 번식한다. 습한 풀밭에 살며 번식도 그곳에서 하고, 6월 무렵 알을 보통 5개 낳는다. 잡초 씨와 조·벼 같은 낟알, 곤충의 어른벌레와 애벌레를 먹는다. 전국에서 볼 수 있고, 국외에서는 시베리아 남부, 러시아 알타이, 트란스바이칼리아, 아무르, 우수리, 만주에 분포한다.

points.en: greenish-grey head from forehead to hindneck
sooty-black lores, area below the eye and chin
pale brown lower mandible with a dark tip
belly and flanks streaked dark olive-brown

art.subject: Black-faced Bunting (Emberiza spodocephala), adult male in spring, as seen on Korean passage in April–May: whole head, nape and breast greenish-grey; lores, the area around the bill base, below the eye and the chin sooty-black, forming a dark face; mantle buff-brown streaked black; lower breast and belly pale yellow, becoming whitish towards the vent; flanks streaked dark olive-brown; wings brown with two pale buff wing bars; tail dark with white outer feathers. Bill with a dark horn upper mandible and a pale pinkish-brown lower mandible tipped dark; dark brown eye; pale pinkish-brown legs.
art.pose: foraging on the ground in damp grass, picking up seeds
art.scene: Korean spring migration: damp grassy meadow with tall grasses; no people, buildings or text
views: adult male, spring, side view perched: greenish-grey head and breast, sooty-black lores and chin, buff-brown mantle streaked black, pale yellow belly, olive-brown streaks on the flanks, pale brown legs

adult female, side view on the ground: brown head with a pale buff supercilium and submoustachial stripe, dark malar stripe, pale yellowish-white underparts with fine dark streaks on the breast and flanks, no grey or black on the face
adult male, head detail in side view: sooty-black lores, area below the eye and chin against the grey head, bill with a dark upper mandible and a pale brown lower mandible with a dark tip
art.build: Small bunting, 16cm, sparrow-sized but slimmer and longer-tailed, keeping low in damp grass and scrub and often flicking the tail open. Rounded head without a crest. Bill conical and pointed, much shorter than the head. Legs short, pale pinkish-brown. At rest the wingtips reach just past the base of the tail. Tail medium length, notched, dark with white outer feathers that show well in flight.
avoid: Do not paint a fully black head; only the face around the bill and the chin are blackish, the rest of the head is grey.
Do not paint a chestnut breast band or rufous rump (Rustic Bunting).
Do not let the grey cover the belly; the belly is pale yellow to whitish.
Do not give it a crest or a yellow throat.
